name: Bold Memberships
summary: Shopify membership and loyalty app by Bold: free and paid tiers, store credit, loyalty points, member pricing and free shipping, gated products and checkout, Shopify POS sign-ups and Apple and Google Wallet cards.
best_for: Shopify stores that want a paid or free membership with store credit, member pricing, free shipping, gated products and checkout, POS sign-ups and wallet cards in one app, and would rather pay per member than a flat monthly fee or a cut of each sale
skip_if: you want to put a large free loyalty tier in front of your whole customer list on a tight budget (each member costs 13 cents a month); you need paid memberships to show up as Shopify orders; or you cannot accept an app that views sensitive customer data and edits orders and store credit
honest_knock: Bold Memberships charges for every member, every month: $0.13 each after the first 10, so a free loyalty tier with 10,000 customers costs about $1,300 a month, and the listing does not say whether free members count. Paid tiers run through Stripe rather than Shopify's checkout; a January 2026 review notes that sign-ups do not appear as Shopify orders. The newest reviews are warm about support, but the 1- and 2-star reviews describe member tags vanishing and customers locked out (2021, 2022), members still charged after the app was deleted (2022), and a 2022 complaint about compatibility with modern themes. The data access is wide, including viewing sensitive customer data and editing orders and store credit. We have not run the app ourselves; this dossier is read from the listing, Bold's product page and the reviews.

pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-11-26 on apps.shopify.com/recurring-memberships: every plan name and amount unchanged; first read 2026-10-05 on the Shopify App Store listing at apps.shopify.com/recurring-memberships, prices in USD) One plan, called Scale: free to install, then $0.13 per member per month. The first 10 members are free forever, the first 30 days are free, and the listing says there is no flat monthly base fee and no transaction fee. All charges are billed in USD. The listing does not define a member; we read it as each customer enrolled in one of your membership tiers, free tiers included, and that is worth confirming before you put a free tier in front of your whole customer list. Paid tiers collect their fees through Stripe (Stripe is listed under 'Works with', and an October 2024 review says membership fees are refunded through Stripe), so Stripe's own processing fees come on top of the app bill. Shopify's own charge notice in our test store on 17 November 2026 repeated the $0.13 per active member rate with the first 10 active members free and added that these pay-per-use charges will not go over a maximum of $10,000 per month.

compare_with.name: Bold Subscriptions
compare_with.why: Bold Subscriptions is in our dossiers too, and Bold builds both; the Memberships listing names it as an integration. They price in opposite ways. Bold Subscriptions sells a product on a schedule and charges $24.99 to $74.99 a month plus a 0.9% to 2% fee on the orders it processes. Bold Memberships sells access and perks, charges $0.13 per member per month with no transaction fee, and takes paid-tier fees through Stripe. If what you sell repeats (coffee, refills, boxes), start with Subscriptions; if what you sell is a status (discounts, early access, member-only products), start with Memberships, and Bold's product page describes running them together, with perks that switch on when a customer subscribes.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Bold Memberships on a Shopify development store: the install, guided setup of a free membership plan with exclusive access and a discount, the review screen with the price, the Shopify test charge (approved without a card, billed 0 dollars) and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. The storefront was not seen. Install: the App Store listing (English, now called Bold Memberships & Loyalty) says Free to install. Additional charges may apply., with a rating of 4.4 from 89 reviews. Install was clicked at about 11:36 and the app opened at about 11:38 after the Install app dialog (customer data, staff and contributor data, view and edit store data). There was no plan choice and no price question at install. The welcome screen says Build a membership that brings customers back. and offers Launch with an expert (Book a call, Start a chat) or Build it yourself with Start guided setup. We did not use the call or the chat. Core action: guided setup in three steps. Step one, Free or paid: plan name Test Member (tag test_member), and we chose Free for all customers (Customers join automatically, at no cost). A checkbox offers to add the 6 existing customers now; the text says that if it is left off, existing customers join when they place an order or click Join Now, and that each member counts toward your app plan's member total. Step two, Rewards and benefits: we chose Exclusive access, with the product Bundle Product #1, and Discounts, 10 percent named Member 10 off on All orders. Step three, Finish initial setup: Open theme editor and Create plans page were skipped, so no theme was changed and no store page was created. The review screen Almost done! shows the plan Test Member, the enrollment Free (all customers) and the benefits Exclusive access and Discounts, and says that Bold Memberships is always $0.13 per month/customer, with no transaction fee, no monthly base fee, Free for your first 10 member signups, and Enterprise pricing for over 5,000 customers. After approval the app said You're all set! Your membership plan is live. with a Polish your plan list (1 of 4 done). Timing, approximate tester observations: about 11 minutes from opening the app at 11:38 to the live plan at about 11:49, in about 14 steps. The plan was seen only in the app: the theme embed was not switched on, so the storefront widget and the gated product were not seen. Listing: Scale at $0.13 per member per month, 100% free for the first 30 days, First 10 members are free forever, No flat monthly base fees and No transaction fees. The app agrees on the price, no base fee and no transaction fee; the review screen says free for your first 10 member signups without the word forever and shows no 30 days free. Checkout: the review screen has one button, Start free trial, which opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen for Scale: You will not be billed for this test charge., This app bills you for usage charges, an App spending limit of a maximum of $10.000,00 USD per 30 days, and Your next bill: You will be billed for this app when you begin to use it. The screen shows no price and an Add payment method row. No card was entered and we approved this test charge at about 11:48, which cost nothing. Members: the app text says each member counts toward your app plan's member total, including free members. This was read from the screen only and was not proven with an invoice. Cancelling: we did not look for a cancel button in the app. Cancelling means uninstalling from Settings, Apps. The dialog Uninstall BOLD Memberships? says you will no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app such as discounts will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete personal customer information. A Reason for uninstalling is required (we chose Testing multiple apps) and feedback is optional. The dialog has no warning about running charges or a refund. Not tested: a paid plan with member payments through Stripe, the storefront widget and the gated product (theme embed off), the wallet card, loyalty points, store credit, Shopify POS, the chat or call and the free setup with the team. Clean up: the app was uninstalled at about 11:55 and is no longer in the list of installed apps; the plan Test Member went with it. No theme change was saved, no page or navigation link was made. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The review screen shows no free period of 30 days and does not say that the first 10 members are free forever, the approval screen shows no price, and the only way to cancel is to uninstall, which needs a reason.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Bold Memberships on a Shopify development store: the install, guided setup of a free membership plan with exclusive access and a discount, the review screen with the price, the Shopify test charge (approved without a card, billed 0 dollars) and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. The storefront was not seen. Install: the App Store listing (English, now called Bold Memberships & Loyalty) says Free to install. Additional charges may apply., with a rating of 4.4 from 89 reviews. Install was clicked at about 11:36 and the app opened at about 11:38 after the Install app dialog (customer data, staff and contributor data, view and edit store data). There was no plan choice and no price question at install. The welcome screen says Build a membership that brings customers back. and offers Launch with an expert (Book a call, Start a chat) or Build it yourself with Start guided setup. We did not use the call or the chat. Core action: guided setup in three steps. Step one, Free or paid: plan name Test Member (tag test_member), and we chose Free for all customers (Customers join automatically, at no cost). A checkbox offers to add the 6 existing customers now; the text says that if it is left off, existing customers join when they place an order or click Join Now, and that each member counts toward your app plan's member total. Step two, Rewards and benefits: we chose Exclusive access, with the product Bundle Product #1, and Discounts, 10 percent named Member 10 off on All orders. Step three, Finish initial setup: Open theme editor and Create plans page were skipped, so no theme was changed and no store page was created. The review screen Almost done! shows the plan Test Member, the enrollment Free (all customers) and the benefits Exclusive access and Discounts, and says that Bold Memberships is always $0.13 per month/customer, with no transaction fee, no monthly base fee, Free for your first 10 member signups, and Enterprise pricing for over 5,000 customers. After approval the app said You're all set! Your membership plan is live. with a Polish your plan list (1 of 4 done). Timing, approximate tester observations: about 11 minutes from opening the app at 11:38 to the live plan at about 11:49, in about 14 steps. The plan was seen only in the app: the theme embed was not switched on, so the storefront widget and the gated product were not seen. Listing: Scale at $0.13 per member per month, 100% free for the first 30 days, First 10 members are free forever, No flat monthly base fees and No transaction fees. The app agrees on the price, no base fee and no transaction fee; the review screen says free for your first 10 member signups without the word forever and shows no 30 days free. Checkout: the review screen has one button, Start free trial, which opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen for Scale: You will not be billed for this test charge., This app bills you for usage charges, an App spending limit of a maximum of $10.000,00 USD per 30 days, and Your next bill: You will be billed for this app when you begin to use it. The screen shows no price and an Add payment method row. No card was entered and we approved this test charge at about 11:48, which cost nothing. Members: the app text says each member counts toward your app plan's member total, including free members. This was read from the screen only and was not proven with an invoice. Cancelling: we did not look for a cancel button in the app. Cancelling means uninstalling from Settings, Apps. The dialog Uninstall BOLD Memberships? says you will no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app such as discounts will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete personal customer information. A Reason for uninstalling is required (we chose Testing multiple apps) and feedback is optional. The dialog has no warning about running charges or a refund. Not tested: a paid plan with member payments through Stripe, the storefront widget and the gated product (theme embed off), the wallet card, loyalty points, store credit, Shopify POS, the chat or call and the free setup with the team. Clean up: the app was uninstalled at about 11:55 and is no longer in the list of installed apps; the plan Test Member went with it. No theme change was saved, no page or navigation link was made. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The review screen shows no free period of 30 days and does not say that the first 10 members are free forever, the approval screen shows no price, and the only way to cancel is to uninstall, which needs a reason.
